variables.description: List of variable definitions in format 'VARIABLE = /path/to/dir'. Used for lcd: paths.

tags.description: List of tag groups. Each tag can have multiple levels (tag1, tag2, etc).

level_item.description: A hierarchical level within a tag (e.g., tag1, tag2).

level_fields.description: Field definition for level_item: tag (level name), name (tag name), print (optional print message).

entry_item.description: An entry (URL with directives) within a level.
